t: This is the Norman Shaw North Building, a Grade I listed building in Westminster. It was designed by Richard Norman Shaw, a British architect who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s. He's considered one of the greatest of British architects, known for his country houses and for commercial buildings, and his influence on style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s. A Grade I listing is the highest level of protection, reserved for buildings of exceptional interest.
